scope: Atomic durable provenance reservations in shared journal, used by closing and generic training readers and validation consumers
atomicity: BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes conflict check, reservation and receipt; reservations persist across failure/restart
acceptance: Validation-first blocks training before data reads
Training-first blocks competing exact-hash or overlapping validation consumption
Both runners reserve before training reads
Two-connection deterministic interleaving and simultaneous contention have exactly one winner
Reservation survives reopen and interruption; failed read does not release exposure
Cross-table SQL guards also reject incompatible inserts from older validation consumer code
Existing nonconflicting behavior and snapshots retained
excluded: Automatic reconciliation of unknown legacy exposure
